expected.title: Construction, stationary phase and composition of homogeneous analytic Fourier integral operators
expected.author: Alix Deleporte
expected.difficulty_reason: After standard smooth FIO geometry and cited analytic microlocal/semiclassical tools, the author constructs a homogeneous analytic operator calculus that preserves analytic function-space regularity: factorial-controlled formal amplitudes and their Borel realizations, complex contour/stationary-phase estimates, and coordinate/phase changes must give analytic-regularizing errors rather than merely exponentially small errors in fixed smooth norms. These estimates are used to define operators consistently across real-analytic cone-bundle charts and prove the actual stationary-phase reduction/composition properties in Theorem4.10. This is one nonroutine H3 analytic-calculus proof core beyond applying smooth FIO composition or treating analytic remainders as smooth ones; the many amplitude/phase helper propositions are supporting parts, not independent extra problems.
